Why Meta Hired India-Born Chirantan 'CJ' Desai as Chief Platform Officer? Know About His History and Work

Meta has appointed former MongoDB CEO Chirantan ‘CJ’ Desai as Chief Enterprise Platform Officer to lead its new enterprise business division. Reporting to Mark Zuckerberg, Desai will oversee efforts to commercialise Meta’s AI models and tools for businesses. MongoDB has named former CEO Dev Ittycher
